about.text: Cheese ripened with the help of insects or mites: the larvae of the cheese fly, Piophila casei, that work through Sardinia's sheep's-milk casu marzu, or the mites that colonise the rinds of France's Mimolette and Germany's Milbenkäse during ripening, which help give them their rind and character.

facts.v: Dried quark balls with salt and caraway, ripened with Tyrolichus casei mites and rye flour for 1–12 months
